info.title: e-Cargoware V1 API
info.description: Standardised API specifications for e-Cargoware operations, utilizing consistent envelopes and standardized naming conventions.

requestBody.description: List of AWB numbers. Each AWB must be 11 numeric digits.

post.summary: Update Export Shipment AWB — only supply fields to change
Search Export Shipments — all filter fields optional
Find Rates — chargeableWt = max(grossWt, dims chargeWt). Dims optional.

post.description: Generates a Freight Booked List (FBL) which is a document used to track cargo bookings made with carriers. Contains key details about each shipment. This endpoint also maps airway bill numbers to the appropriate communication emails for the flight if available.

post.summary: Find available routes between two airports and carriers
Search Customers — all fields are optional

post.description: Return List of Rates , Routes for Platform
Return List of Rate , Routes & Charges

get.summary: Find Shipment Details by AWB No
